physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Initial untried candidate; captured inputs contain only the qualified baseline and no candidate history or feedback. Keep baseline utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0 and repair_margin=0 because baseline setup slack is only 0.19292 ns, hold slack is 0.114491 ns, and all reported electrical violation counts are zero. Enable the proved exact signed 18-bit reduction to target arithmetic area and switching, and request-qualified operand isolation to target unnecessary multiplier activity without changing the cycle contract. Isolation adds gating area and may affect delay; width reduction may offset these costs, but neither benefit is measured yet. Avoid additional physical or area-mapping changes in this first evaluation. Minimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6), not die area. Require physical_qualified, measurement_qualified and rank_eligible; inspect setup/hold slack, electrical violations, correctness and annotation checks, all three workload energies, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, failure_classes and elapsed costs. Retain failures and the best qualified result. Energy comparisons are limited to the stated Liberty-model zero-delay activity plus extracted-SPEF scope; this proposal claims no measured improvement.
